title: Fernando Diniz Matches Tite’s Record at Corinthians
subtitle: The coach reaches 14 games without conceding and stands out at the club
excerpt: Fernando Diniz achieves a significant defensive milestone at Corinthians, matching Tite’s performance and surpassing other coaches of the club.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The coach Fernando Diniz reached an impressive milestone in his tenure at Corinthians by completing 25 matches at the helm. The defensive performance implemented by the manager drew attention and placed him alongside Tite at the top of the club’s ranking.

Defensive performance matches historic record

After his first 25 games in charge of Corinthians, Fernando Diniz achieved 14 matches without conceding. With this number, the coach matched the performance achieved by the team under Tite between the 2010 and 2011 seasons.

The record surpassed the performance of other coaches who passed through the club in their first 25 matches. Mano Menezes recorded 13 games without conceding in 2008, while Fábio Carille reached 12 games between 2016 and 2017. Vítor Pereira completed the list with 11 games in the same period in 2022.

Change of style and focus on results

Although historically known for a more offensive style of play and a constant pursuit of ball possession, Diniz adopted a more pragmatic stance at Corinthians. The team began to show greater concern about not conceding goals, adapting to the urgency for results and the club’s profile.

Physical problems and squad limitations also influenced the start of the work, leading the team to a more conservative plan. Even with restrictions and without publicly demanding reinforcements, the coach managed to adjust the squad to achieve defensive solidity.

Restoration of playing time for squad members

While the team seeks to maintain momentum in the season, the internal scenario also changed for some players. Right‑back Pedro Milans, for example, lost playing time in the early months of Diniz’s tenure due to adaptation difficulties, but regained prestige after good responses in training and in the matches where he was used.

The player has come to be treated internally as the main alternative for the right‑back position, reflecting the working dynamic implemented by the technical staff over the months.

With information from UOL, CNN Brasil.
